channel.description: AI-generated daily recap of activity in the Ente Community Discord server

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 27, 2026 - 23 messages in 4 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw light activity across four channels, with discussion focused mainly on border-device privacy, photo metadata/import behavior, and community contributions. Off-topic was the busiest channel, followed by photos.

#off-topic

Twelve messages from six participants discussed border searches, device resets, access requests, and related legal considerations in the US, Canada, and elsewhere. Members also discussed a recent rise in community pull requests, with one participant noting 43 PRs, and shared Kill the Cookie Banner.

#photos

Eight messages from four participants covered delays in new photos appearing in galleries, Immich’s importer behavior, sidecar files, EXIF date parsing, and compatibility with Google’s formats. The channel also briefly discussed iOS deletion permissions and the use of tags such as [mobile][photos] in pull requests.

#ensu

Two participants discussed improving model selection for systems with under or over 16 GB of RAM and troubleshooting a related setup. A follow-up offered to investigate after receiving more details.

#memes

One attachment was shared.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 26, 2026 - 12 messages in 3 channels
item.description:
Activity was modest, with 12 messages across three channels. Discussion centered on Ente Photos features and workflows, alongside a brief off-topic privacy conversation and two new-user introductions.

#photos

Five messages from four participants covered Ente Photos collages, how cloud uploads affect the home gallery, bulk photo rotation, and syncing Ente with locally hosted Immich. One participant also mentioned opening a PR for straightening, horizon leveling, or image rotation.

#off-topic

Five messages from three participants discussed phone privacy, device resets, and access to sensitive data. The conversation included a news article about GrapheneOS’s duress PIN and comments that its media coverage may be sensationalized.

#introduce-yourself

Two newcomers introduced themselves: one is exploring privacy-focused AI, while another is getting started with Ente Photos from Southern Europe.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 23, 2026 - 17 messages in 5 channels
item.description:
Activity was light, with 17 messages across five channels. Most discussion centered on RSS discovery and filtering in #off-topic, alongside brief technical chatter about self-hosting, Scaleway, and Ente Auth.

#off-topic

Nine messages from six participants covered Windows VPN privacy, browser preferences, RSS feeds and aggregators, noisy content filtering, and whether Ente accepts UI or feature contributions. One discussion shared a Windows Latest article.

#photos

Three messages from one participant praised self-hosting while reacting to a possible Scaleway outage and “OOMs.”

#memes

Three participants shared two meme attachments, along with a reminder to keep language appropriate for under-18 members.

#introduce-yourself

One brief greeting was posted.

#auth

A user asked whether Ente Auth works with the macOS Alfred app.
